title: Jacob Returns to Bethel

questions.question: Where did God tell Jacob to go?
questions.explanation: Genesis 35:1 (ESV): "God said to Jacob, 'Arise, go up to Bethel and dwell there.'"

questions.question: Who died and was buried near Bethlehem?
questions.explanation: Genesis 35:19: "So Rachel died, and she was buried on the way to Ephrath (that is, Bethlehem)."

questions.question: What was the name of the son born as Rachel was dying?
questions.explanation: Genesis 35:18: Rachel named him Ben-oni, but Jacob called him Benjamin.

questions.question: How many sons did Jacob have?
questions.explanation: Genesis 35:22-26: Jacob had twelve sons total.

questions.question: Who died at the age of 180 years?
questions.explanation: Genesis 35:28: "Now the days of Isaac were 180 years."

questions.question: What did Jacob tell his household to do before going to Bethel?
options: Put away foreign gods and purify themselves
questions.correctAnswer: Put away foreign gods and purify themselves
questions.explanation: Genesis 35:2: "Put away the foreign gods that are among you and purify yourselves and change your garments."

questions.question: What did God rename Jacob?
questions.explanation: Genesis 35:10: "Your name is Jacob; no longer shall your name be called Jacob, but Israel shall be your name."

questions.question: What name did Rachel give her newborn before she died?
questions.explanation: Genesis 35:18: Rachel called him Ben-oni (son of my sorrow), but Jacob called him Benjamin.

questions.question: What sin did Reuben commit?
options: He lay with Bilhah, his father's concubine
questions.correctAnswer: He lay with Bilhah, his father's concubine
questions.explanation: Genesis 35:22: "Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father's concubine. And Israel heard of it."

questions.question: Who buried Isaac?
questions.explanation: Genesis 35:29: "Esau and Jacob his sons buried him."

questions.question: Where did Jacob hide the foreign gods?
options: Under the terebinth tree near Shechem
questions.correctAnswer: Under the terebinth tree near Shechem
questions.explanation: Genesis 35:4: "Jacob hid them under the terebinth tree that was near Shechem."

questions.question: Who was Deborah in this chapter?
questions.explanation: Genesis 35:8: "And Deborah, Rebekah's nurse, died, and she was buried under an oak below Bethel."

questions.question: What did Jacob set up at the place where God spoke to him?
options: A pillar of stone and poured a drink offering on it
questions.correctAnswer: A pillar of stone and poured a drink offering on it
questions.explanation: Genesis 35:14: "Jacob set up a pillar...a pillar of stone. He poured out a drink offering on it and poured oil on it."

questions.question: What promise did God reaffirm to Jacob at Bethel?
options: A nation and kings would come from him
questions.correctAnswer: A nation and kings would come from him
questions.explanation: Genesis 35:11: "A nation and a company of nations shall come from you, and kings shall spring from you."

questions.question: Where was Jacob when Rachel began giving birth?
questions.explanation: Genesis 35:16: "Then they journeyed from Bethel. When they were still some distance from Ephrath, Rachel went into labor."

key_verse_text: Your name is Jacob; no longer shall your name be called Jacob, but Israel shall be your name.
